name: Group Chat
blurb: The intro plays out as a phone text thread: a friend's bubble asks the question, every VO line comes back as your blue bubble (key words bold), B-roll lands as photo messages with a 'delivered' tick, typing dots between; on the turn the friend replies 'WAIT WHAT' and the thread races; the title arrives as a pinned message banner.
off_why: off with R12 (s25 ultra 2026-10-23): a phone text thread is a narrow column, the user never wants a narrow intro
